title: 快取一致性多核心系統
summary: 以一致性狀態、目錄與共享粒度連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect coherence states, directories and sharing granularity through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.title: 共享記憶體契約
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「共享記憶體契約」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop shared-memory contracts through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 快取一致性與記憶體順序：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Coherence and consistency: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「快取一致性與記憶體順序」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for coherence and consistency.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「快取一致性與記憶體順序」的資料、控制與時間關係。單一位址一致性不等於全域記憶體順序。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分類單位址與雙位址測試。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for coherence and consistency. Single-address coherence is not global memory ordering. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Classify one- and two-address tests. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 分類單位址與雙位址測試。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：一致性快取可取代所有同步原語。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Coherent caches replace all synchronization primitives. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「快取一致性與記憶體順序」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「單一位址一致性不等於全域記憶體順序。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit coherence and consistency two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 快取一致性與記憶體順序的原理與邊界
knowledge.titleEn: Coherence and consistency principle and boundaries
knowledge.text: 單一位址一致性不等於全域記憶體順序。
knowledge.textEn: Single-address coherence is not global memory ordering.

knowledge.title: 快取一致性與記憶體順序的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 分類單位址與雙位址測試。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Classify one- and two-address tests. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設快取行 64 B，每秒 10⁷ 次行擁有權移轉，僅計每次 64 B 資料，交通下界=640 MB/s（十進位）。未計請求、確認、重試與互連標頭；填補不是免費。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 64 B cache lines and 10⁷ ownership transfers/s. Counting 64 B payload per transfer gives a 640 MB/s decimal traffic lower bound; requests, acknowledgments, retries and headers are excluded.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「快取一致性多核心系統」的「快取一致性與記憶體順序：原理與架構」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「算力中心：核心不是答案」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Coherence and consistency: principles and architecture” in “Cache-coherent multicore systems”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 本步審查「快取一致性與記憶體順序」與整體「快取一致性多核心系統」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing coherence and consistency within cache-coherent multicore systems, which statement or check is supported?
options: 單一位址一致性不等於全域記憶體順序。
一致性快取可取代所有同步原語。
填補變數會消除所有真共享。
optionsEn: Single-address coherence is not global memory ordering.
Coherent caches replace all synchronization primitives.
Padding eliminates all true sharing.
quiz.explanation: 單一位址一致性不等於全域記憶體順序。 分類單位址與雙位址測試。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Single-address coherence is not global memory ordering. Classify one- and two-address tests. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 快取一致性與記憶體順序：實驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Coherence and consistency: experiment and validation
steps.objective: 用「分類單位址與雙位址測試。」檢查「快取一致性與記憶體順序」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for coherence and consistency using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「快取一致性與記憶體順序」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：分類單位址與雙位址測試。 核對「單一位址一致性不等於全域記憶體順序。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for coherence and consistency and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Classify one- and two-address tests. Check the principle: Single-address coherence is not global memory ordering. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 分類單位址與雙位址測試。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：一致性快取可取代所有同步原語。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Coherent caches replace all synchronization primitives. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「快取一致性與記憶體順序」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「分類單位址與雙位址測試。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit coherence and consistency input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「讀取共享」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：畫兩核心讀取後狀態。 核對「多讀者可保留乾淨共享副本。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for shared reads and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Draw states after two-core reads. Check the principle: Readers can hold clean shared copies. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：一致性快取可取代所有同步原語。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Coherent caches replace all synchronization primitives. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「讀取共享」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「畫兩核心讀取後狀態。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit shared reads input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.title: 寫入擁有權：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「寫入擁有權」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for write ownership.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「寫入擁有權」的資料、控制與時間關係。修改通常需排除其他有效副本。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「追蹤一次讀後寫入。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for write ownership. Writes usually invalidate other valid copies. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace a read followed by a write. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observationEn: Trace a read followed by a write.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：填補變數會消除所有真共享。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Padding eliminates all true sharing. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「寫入擁有權」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「修改通常需排除其他有效副本。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit write ownership two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
